implementation_boundary: The R1-R9 design blockers are resolved in the planning text. Exact wire models, database constraints and transactions, lock ordering, SDK behavior, migrations, and native acceptance evidence remain implementation gates.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0044 lines 37-47 now separate immutable logical batch/receipt identity from authoring TaskRun, attempt, and physical owner epoch. Owner data is commit-time fencing and audit evidence; replacement resolves the original accepted identity.
resolution_review.future_gate: DDL must enforce one logical accepted outcome for the input/apply coordinate while storing the author fence separately. Real lost-response plus owner-replacement tests must prove lookup without duplicate output, state, or cursor movement.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0044 lines 81-90 distinguish the proposed versioned OUTPUT(value)/NO_OUTPUT language profile from epoch-1's internal state-only RETURN wire. JSON null remains a value, and old RETURN receipts are not reinterpreted.
resolution_review.future_gate: Wire tags, receipt decoding, migration behavior, and real round trips for OUTPUT(null), OUTPUT(value), NO_OUTPUT, and historical RETURN remain unimplemented.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0043 lines 47-74 define graph-revision-bound edge identities, distinct producer and edge partitions, append-time materialized forward/rebalance/broadcast/keyed exchanges, persisted route digests, edge-local sequences, exact retry, and independent branch cursors/retention.
resolution_review.future_gate: Schema cardinalities, transaction size limits, per-edge uniqueness, route-set exact replay, and different-partitioner branch tests remain native implementation work.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0044 lines 96-115 define coordinator/assignment-fenced cut identity, immutable participant/input manifests, DATA and BARRIER in one partition order, pre-cut route durability, participant roots, one global COMPLETE marker, scope rules, and complete-only restore/GC/rescale authority.
resolution_review.future_gate: The coordinator API, ordered record schema, participant acknowledgements, pin lifecycle, abort protocol, and crash matrix remain unimplemented.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0045 lines 49-67 place DATA, WATERMARK, IDLE, RESUME, EOF, and DRAIN in one fenced split order; bind controls to source positions and digests; persist read permits before external reads; and freeze discovery, assignment, intents, and positions in an immutable drain frontier.
resolution_review.future_gate: Connector-specific rewind/acknowledgement adapters, exact control DTOs, reactivation policy, and process-loss tests remain required for every admitted connector profile.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0046 lines 49-74 reserve the complete bounded turn vector before user invocation, including output/routes/state/join/inbox/timer/receipt/index/control costs; define fenced reservation identity, atomic all-or-wait acquisition, exact conversion/refund/reclamation, lock/fair-wait order, control headroom, and refusal of unbounded joins/resource cycles.
resolution_review.future_gate: Per-profile size accounting, PostgreSQL amplification calibration, lock implementation, fairness, and failure tests must prove that the declared maximum covers the actual transaction.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0047 lines 48-69 define one immutable regional recovery plan, RESTORING targets with no business/data authority, participant attestations, one atomic READY activation, unaffected-region continuity, resumable/abortable pre-activation loss, exact lost-response resolution, and cancellation precedence.
resolution_review.future_gate: Placement/provider stop witnesses, recovery-plan persistence, atomic capability activation, and real separate-host fault cuts remain mandatory native evidence.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0048 lines 46-68 extend the rescale manifest to source enumerator/split/read/append state; edge/mailbox holes; state/join/timer/watermark/idleness state; capacity, refund, and retention pins; capabilities, placement, retry budgets, and leases. Every component must transfer, resolve before cut, or reject admission.
resolution_review.future_gate: The transfer schema, ownership CAS, compatibility matrix, pin/refund behavior, and two-to-three-subtask native rescale tests remain unimplemented.

resolution_review.evidence: ADR-0043 lines 76-101 specify bounded tagged-key-v1 canonical bytes for None, exact bool, signed-64 integer, strict UTF-8 string, and bytes; reject floats/structured/custom values; use SHA-256 and persisted routing parameters; and require canonical tagged JSON transport.
resolution_review.future_gate: Golden vectors, strict SDK/server decoders, manifest validation, supported-runtime compatibility, and pre-DATA refusal tests remain required.

standalone_probe_boundary.assessment: The probe is consistent with the journaled-state theory and its negative controls. It remains a standalone model and earns no native SDK, HTTP, PostgreSQL, worker, multi-input, rescale, or cross-host acceptance.

remaining_implementation_gates: Freeze versioned public SDK and HTTP DTOs only after translating each identity and refusal in these ADRs into explicit fields and compatibility rules.

Define paired PostgreSQL and SQLite schemas, uniqueness and CHECK constraints, transaction isolation, row/advisory lock order, and exact retry receipts; SQLite mutations must continue to fail closed where the profile requires PostgreSQL.

Prove the first fixed finite physical-subtask slice with ordinary Prefect Tasks, real API and PostgreSQL, separate OS processes, stable metadata counts, region admission, stale-owner fencing, and before/after terminal fault cuts.

Add native fan-out/exchange, multi-input and NO_OUTPUT, continuous source controls, online retention/pressure, regional replacement, rescale, compatibility, and cross-host gates incrementally; no ADR becomes accepted from text or the standalone probe.
Record capacity and load limits from declared workloads and hardware. No production HA, throughput, connector parity, or Flink-equivalence claim follows from this design review.
recommended_next_action: Publish ADR-0042 through ADR-0048 with their current planning/progress statuses, retain zero new native readiness, and proceed to the epoch's first bounded physical-subtask vertical slice. Treat the exact wire, DDL, lock, migration, and real-system AC work as implementation gates rather than further design-approval blockers.
